statements.t: The Company intends to continue our focus on originating fixed-rate one-to-four family residential mortgage loans, and to a lesser extent residential construction loans and home equity lines of credit.

Markets rates for our fixed rate loan products have generally risen in recent months as the Federal Reserve increased rates during its September meeting in reaction to continued higher levels of inflation than its target rate of inflation.

While we have experienced a reduction in our overall cost of funds which has resulted in an increase in our net interest income, we expect this recent rise in rates by the Federal Reserve will increase our overall cost of funds in the future.
We expect this trend of reduced loan demand to continue until overall market conditions improve the affordability of homeownership.
We anticipate, given the current market rates, for there to be pressure on loan origination volume.
Management intends to continue its efforts to increase core deposits, with an emphasis on growth in consumer deposits.
The Company will continue to evaluate the need for a valuation allowance against these deferred items and will adjust the valuation allowance as deemed appropriate.
We monitor our liquidity on a daily basis and anticipate that we will have sufficient funds to meet our current funding commitments.
Based on our deposit retention experience and current pricing strategy, we anticipate that a significant portion of maturing time deposits can be retained.
Management expects that a substantial portion of the maturing certificates of deposit will be renewed.
